ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (black) dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity pixels (white) localized primarily at the fluke tips and scattered along the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white clusters (approx. 50-100 pixel diameter) mapped to the distal tips; sparse circular white points (approx. 5-10 pixel diameter) scattered on the central right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate 50-degree internal angle, oriented vertically at the base of the bifurcation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medium-to-high frequency serration profile; continuous chain of jagged peaks (3-10 pixel amplitude) along the trailing edge from notch to tip, most pronounced on the superior right lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-lobed sweep consisting of a convex proximal curve transitioning into a concave distal taper towards the pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) located at the terminal points of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel diagonal linear streaks of lighter-intensity pixels located on the mid-medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified texture and white pigmentation on the distal edges of both lobes, indicating significant colonization or persistent scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged protrusion on the extreme left tip and right tip caused by dense, multi-layered barnacle clusters.
